description: Use this when someone asks what their own customers or buyers have already told them: why they choose, churn or switch, what they think of pricing, onboarding or a competitor. It answers from the workspace's completed GatherHQ studies and the files added to GatherHQ, with counted numbers, word-for-word quotes, what to do and a confidence; when the research does not cover the question, it says so. Ask one standalone question that names the group instead of "they", e.g. "What would make CIOs switch?". The question and the start of the answer are saved to the workspace. Share the answer as written. Do not use it to test something new (a message, price, feature or ad the research has not covered): use gather_report_start, gather_run_simulation or gather_test_creatives. For quotes alone use gather_find_quotes; for a study's status, gather_list_studies.

question.description: One standalone question about your customers, e.g. "What would make CIOs switch?"

study_id.description: Point the answer at this study (an id from gather_list_studies).
